title: In exitu Israel I (Senfl)
desc: Ludwig Senfl, In exitu Israel I. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
